newsitem.title: USA: United Auto to offer $150 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: United Auto to offer $150 mln of notes.

text.p: United Auto Group Inc plans to offer $150 million of unregistered senior subordinated notes due 2007.
Proceeds of the offering are expected to be about $143 million after the initial purchasers discount and estimated expenses, United Auto said in a statement on Friday.
United Auto plans to use $50 million of the net proceeds to repay the $50 million of outstanding borrowings under its credit facility.

The balance of the net proceeds will be deposited with the company's floor plan lenders to be available for working capital and other general corporate purposes, including acquisitions of dealerships, the company said.
